title: Fixed-capacity KV cache
summary: Append keys and values to a preallocated cache, attend one query over the valid prefix, and reject an append past the capacity.

mutants.capacity_off_by_one: Raises when the append ends exactly at max_len, so the last slot of the cache is never used.
mutants.count_before_check: Adds n to the length before the capacity check, so a failed append leaves a wrong length.
mutants.full_buffer_view: Returns the whole buffer from keys() and values(), so attention also sees the empty zero rows.
mutants.length_plus_one: Adds 1 to the length after each append, also when the append has several steps.
mutants.no_scale: Forgets to divide the scores by sqrt(d_k) in decode_step.
mutants.overwrite_from_zero: Writes each append at row 0, so new steps overwrite the old steps.
